Alana (CS): FYI Quokka Labs reporting slow chat replies during peak today, intermittent timeouts. Anyone tracking this cluster?
Sam (ML Eng): Looking now. Their traces show lots of cache misses and long system+context prefixes (many >200 tokens).
Diego (Platform): Repro'd on the dedicated pool. CPU and GPU kernel overhead spikes for seq_len > 120. We should consider a two-prong approach: lightweight quantized variant + prefix-based routing to a large-context model for long prompts.
Rina (Solutions): Quokka said they can tolerate up to ~1% quality regression for latency wins; they want a tested rollback plan.
Alana (CS): Proposal: canary int8 quantized model at 10% traffic, prefix-routing rule (prefix_tokens > 120 -> large-context model), and enable prefix KV caching with 12h TTL. Agree?
Diego (Platform): Agree. Draft rule below to push as a routing policy snippet:
```json
{"policy":"prefix-routing","rules":[{"match":{"prefix_tokens_gt":120},"route_to":"redwood-large-v2"},{"match":{"prefix_tokens_lte":120},"route_to":"redwood-opt-q4_0-int8"}],"canary":{"percent":10}}
```
Sam (ML Eng): Running a targeted 100-prompt eval from their corpus against int8 canary and baseline. Command: `runtest --customer quokka --model redwood-opt-q4_0-int8 --prompts evals/quokka_100.json`
ops-bot: Canary deploy queued: deploy-canary-44211 -> 10% on pool 'dedicated-quokka'. ETA ~12m.
Diego (Platform): I'll add alerts: rollback if p95 latency increases > 100ms sustained 2m OR quality delta > 2%. Also adding soft fallback to hosted-small.
Sam (ML Eng): Eval results: avg quality delta 0.7%, tail latency down ~38% on canary traffic. CSV uploaded to ticket.
Rina (Solutions): I'll run Wed 10am PT customer sync to walk through expected behavior and rollback steps.
Alana (CS): Great. Action items: @Sam finish full 200-prompt run, @Diego watch canary and set traces tag `quokka-canary-2026`, @Rina lead customer sync. I'll update the CSM runbook after results. :thumbsup:
